leadText:
Sable City (Japanese: サビシティ Sabi City) is a small -exclusive town located in Kanto, very close to Pewter City.

In The Ole' Berate and Switch!, Sable City held a one-day Pokémon Tournament, in which entered to train for his upcoming match at the Battle Pyramid. Ash participated with his , who helped him win against Howie and Oriba. However, Max accidentally discovered that Team Rocket's Butch and Cassidy had created the event as a scheme to steal all the competitors' Pokémon and give them to . Ash and joined forces with the other Trainers to defeat the plot, while the Team Rocket trio helped and decided to get their revenge on rivals Butch and Cassidy.
